definition: born a very short time ago
description: A bright living room with plants on the windowsill. A white-haired woman in a cream cable sweater sits on a sofa cradling a tiny swaddled baby whose face is still red and crumpled, only days old. She smiles down at it. A second older woman sits beside her and rests a hand on the bundle, then a teenage boy and a young woman lean in from either side. All four gather around the baby and finally look up at the camera, smiling, the infant still asleep in the great-grandmother's arms.
